newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound almost unchanged vs. dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound almost unchanged vs. dollar.

text.p: The dollar's average bid rate against the Egyptian pound was up while that for the offered rate fell in the private-sector market on Thursday, bankers said.
The bankers say factors that have been affecting the market lately remain unchanged.
They have said the dollar is in demand by public sector banks ahead of the end of the financial year on June 30 and by foreign mutual funds.
Private-sector bankers said the dollar ranged from 3.3940 pounds to 3.3970 pounds bid and from 3.3965 pounds to 3.3985 offered in the interbank market.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3955 pounds bid and 3.3975 offered. The averages compare to 3.3950 pounds bid and 3.3981 pounds offered on Wednesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.394988 buy and 3.399180 sell.
